mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_delivery.assistant ( tenant_id, id, display_name, latest_version_number, version, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{id}, #{displayName}, #{latestVersionNumber}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO assistant_delivery.assistant_request ( tenant_id, operation, idempotency_key_hash, request_fingerprint, assistant_id, assistant_version_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{operation}, #{keyHash}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{assistantId}, #{assistantVersionId}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, display_name, latest_version_number, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM assistant_delivery.assistant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{assistantId}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, display_name, latest_version_number, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM assistant_delivery.assistant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{assistantId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, display_name, latest_version_number, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM assistant_delivery.assistant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, display_name, latest_version_number, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at FROM assistant_delivery.assistant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (created_at, id) < (#{createdAt}, #{id}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH latest_published AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (assistant.id) assistant.id AS assistant_id, assistant.display_name, version.id AS assistant_version_id, version.version_number, version.published_at FROM assistant_delivery.assistant AS assistant JOIN assistant_delivery.assistant_version AS version ON version.tenant_id = assistant.tenant_id AND version.assistant_id = assistant.id WHERE assistant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY assistant.id, version.version_number DESC, version.id DESC ) SELECT assistant_id::text AS assistant_id, display_name, assistant_version_id::text AS assistant_version_id, version_number, published_at FROM latest_published ORDER BY published_at DESC, assistant_version_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH latest_published AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (assistant.id) assistant.id AS assistant_id, assistant.display_name, version.id AS assistant_version_id, version.version_number, version.published_at FROM assistant_delivery.assistant AS assistant JOIN assistant_delivery.assistant_version AS version ON version.tenant_id = assistant.tenant_id AND version.assistant_id = assistant.id WHERE assistant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY assistant.id, version.version_number DESC, version.id DESC ) SELECT assistant_id::text AS assistant_id, display_name, assistant_version_id::text AS assistant_version_id, version_number, published_at FROM latest_published WHERE (published_at, assistant_version_id) < (#{publishedAt}, #{assistantVersionId}) ORDER BY published_at DESC, assistant_version_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_delivery.assistant_version ( tenant_id, id, assistant_id, version_number, chat_deployment_id, chat_deployment_revision, chat_deployment_output_limit, knowledge_space_id, index_version_id, index_version_revision, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, system_instruction, max_output_tokens, retrieval_limit, minimum_score, citation_policy, refusal_policy, status, version, created_by, created_at, published_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{id}, #{assistantId}, #{versionNumber}, #{chatDeploymentId}, #{chatDeploymentRevision}, #{chatDeploymentOutputLimit}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{indexVersionId}, #{indexVersionRevision}, #{embeddingDeploymentId}, #{embeddingDeploymentRevision}, #{embeddingDimension}, #{systemInstruction}, #{maxOutputTokens}, #{retrievalLimit}, #{minimumScore}, #{citationPolicy}, #{refusalPolicy}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, id::text AS id, assistant_id::text AS assistant_id, version_number, chat_deployment_id, chat_deployment_revision, chat_deployment_output_limit, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, index_version_id::text AS index_version_id, index_version_revision, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, system_instruction, max_output_tokens, retrieval_limit, minimum_score, citation_policy, refusal_policy, status, version, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, published_at FROM assistant_delivery.assistant_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{assistantVersionId}
